mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INTERFACE_SCHEDULE ( SCHEDULE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, SCHEDULE_NAME, SCHEDULE_DESC, EXECUTION_PROGRAM, APPLY_FROM_DATE, APPLY_TO_DATE, MONTH, WEEK, DAY, HOUR, MINUTES, STATUS, SYSTEM_BATCH_YN, BATCH_YYYYMM, BATCH_YYYYMM_YN, EXEC_TYPE, EXEC_MANUAL_START_YYYYMM, EXEC_MANUAL_END_YYYYMM, EXEC_DAILY_PERIOD, EXEC_MONTHLY_PERIOD, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY ) VALUES ( #{schedule_code}, #{company_code}, #{schedule_name}, #{schedule_desc}, NULLIF(#{execution_program}, ''), #{apply_from_date}, NULLIF(#{apply_to_date}, ''), NULLIF(#{month}, ''), NULLIF(#{week}, ''), NULLIF(#{day}, ''), NULLIF(#{hour}, ''), NULLIF(#{minutes}, ''), '0', #{system_batch_yn}, NULLIF(#{batch_yyyymm}, ''), #{batch_yyyymm_yn}, NULLIF(#{exec_type}, ''), NULLIF(#{exec_manual_start_yyyymm}, ''), NULLIF(#{exec_manual_end_yyyymm}, ''), CAST(NULLIF(#{exec_daily_period}, '') AS SMALLINT), CAST(NULLIF(#{exec_monthly_period}, '') AS SMALLINT), NOW(), #{update_by}, NOW(), #{update_by} )
mapper.update: UPDATE INTERFACE_SCHEDULE SET SCHEDULE_NAME = #{schedule_name}, SCHEDULE_DESC = #{schedule_desc}, EXECUTION_PROGRAM = NULLIF(#{execution_program}, ''), APPLY_FROM_DATE = #{apply_from_date}, APPLY_TO_DATE = NULLIF(#{apply_to_date}, ''), MONTH = NULLIF(#{month}, ''), WEEK = NULLIF(#{week}, ''), DAY = NULLIF(#{day}, ''), HOUR = NULLIF(#{hour}, ''), MINUTES = NULLIF(#{minutes}, ''), SYSTEM_BATCH_YN = #{system_batch_yn}, BATCH_YYYYMM = NULLIF(#{batch_yyyymm}, ''), BATCH_YYYYMM_YN = #{batch_yyyymm_yn}, EXEC_TYPE = NULLIF(#{exec_type}, ''), EXEC_MANUAL_START_YYYYMM = NULLIF(#{exec_manual_start_yyyymm}, ''), EXEC_MANUAL_END_YYYYMM = NULLIF(#{exec_manual_end_yyyymm}, ''), EXEC_DAILY_PERIOD = CAST(NULLIF(#{exec_daily_period}, '') AS SMALLINT), EXEC_MONTHLY_PERIOD = CAST(NULLIF(#{exec_monthly_period}, '') AS SMALLINT), UPDATE_DATE = NOW(), UPDATE_BY = #{update_by} WHERE SCHEDULE_CODE = #{schedule_code} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code}
